## Static findings that affect the finite observations

| Existing method | Source behavior to capture, not a Go-derived expectation |
|---|---|
| `init_plugin` (`app/core/plugin.py:121`) | Missing running object returns `None`. Otherwise `init_plugin(conf)` → `get_state()` → enable/disable event handler → agent-tool cache clear/revision increment. A callback exception interrupts later steps; the method does not catch it. |
| `remove_plugin` (`:634`) | Delegates to original `stop(pid)`: disable handler → close → stop service; pop class/running maps, clear module cache, clear agent cache. `__stop_plugin` has one try around close and stop, so a close error skips stop_service. Class-only failed-init entries are still removed. |
| `delete_plugin_config` (`:815`) | Unless force, absent/falsy class returns `False` without DAO call. Otherwise returns original `SystemConfigOper.delete` result. That operator pops its in-memory cache before querying/deleting persistent config; failure can leave cache changed while SQLite row remains. |
| `delete_plugin_data` (`:825`) | Same class/force gate; original PluginDataOper deletes all rows for only that plugin ID, then Manager returns `True`, including no matching rows. DAO exceptions propagate. |
| `get_plugin_state` (`:836`) | Returns original callback value verbatim, not `bool(value)`; missing/falsy object yields `False`; callback exceptions propagate. |
| `get_local_plugins` (`:1375`) | Iterates classes, reads installed IDs, constructs `schemas.Plugin()`, then assigns fields individually. Catches get_state failure to False; checks real method implementation; auth filtering follows state/page evaluation; stable sort by assigned plugin_order. Preserve defaults and ordinary returned JSON values. |
| `remove_plugin_job` (`app/scheduler.py:1251`) | Inactive scheduler no-op. With explicit nonempty job_id, pops that exact service without checking its pid; otherwise selects by pid. Registry entries are removed before scheduler calls. Physical jobs match `job.id.split('|')[0]`; JobLookupError is ignored, other service errors reach message sink. |
| `update_plugin_job` (`:1338`) | Inactive/empty pid no-op. Removes all old plugin services before service lookup. Each new service uses `pid + '_' + service['id']`, prefix before `|`, then remove same prefix, install registry entry, add job. Registry insertion precedes add_job failure; each service error is logged/notified and iteration continues. |

### Schema semantics, without assuming coercion

Actual `app/schemas/plugin.py` declares `Plugin(BaseModel)` and has no model_config override or assignment validator. The inspected existing Pydantic 2.13.4 source defaults `validate_assignment=False`; its normal model-field assignment stores the value in `__dict__`. Thus `state: Optional[bool]` does **not** establish bool coercion for these assignments. The eventual source capture must record callback value/type and the assigned field, including one standard JSON non-bool value, plus normal Plugin defaults. This is a static conclusion; Pydantic was not imported in this preparation. No all-schema/type matrix is proposed.
